name: Chapel of Xi Ru
title: Chapel of Xi Ru
summary: A chapel much like the Ithaenc Cathedral on Xi Ru's Island, reached by the Portalling Device, with Xi Ru's Chapel dungeon below (acpedia). In the kit it is a cross-shaped chapel of green-stone towers (tops z 33-54) on an island at sea level, ringed by water channels. Portal swirls sit on its three tapered towers and golden leaf sculptures dot the lawns. Directly behind it a 234 m cliff rises to a plateau lake holding another giant Deru tree (top z 342).

landmarks.name: South tower with rooftop portal (0x010034F7)
landmarks.note: Xi Ru's Chapel portal at z 39.

site.name: Chapel of Xi Ru
site.notes: No gazetteer entry for the chapel itself; the exact teleports nearby are portals (Xi Ru's Chapel Portal on the south tower, Roots of the Deru Tree Portal) or the Portalling Device 135 m south, so a derived @teleloc on the open island ground 45 m south of the south tower is used (ground z 0.0, nearest bush 5.6 m). Landblocks south of y 2496 (0xEB0C-0xEE0C) and east of x 45696 (0xEE0D-0xEE0F) are missing from the kit.

shots.standingOrder: Fly north 72 m up straight over the chapel's cross of towers and their rooftop portal swirls, the gimbal holding the central hall through the vertical as the cliff wall rises ahead; stay 17 m above the highest roof.
shots.notes: Pass-over flying north 72 m up across the chapel's cross of green-stone towers and the portal swirls on their roofs. The gimbal holds the central hall through the vertical while the 234 m cliff wall rises ahead. The midday sun (0.58) is behind the lens. The camera stays 18 m above the highest roof. shots.standingOrder: Jib up 12 m from the island's south lawn toward the chapel's south tower and the portal swirl on its roof, swinging 18 degrees, the sun behind the lens; keep 4 m from the bushes.

shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up south-south-west from the chapel's towers with the sun behind you until Xi Ru's island chapel sits small in its water channels at the foot of the 230 m cliff crowned by the Deru tree; 15 m above every tower.
